trigger_match: common.py ResidualSteerer (x' = x + alpha*v additive residual at blocks.26)
steering_coefficient_sweep.capability_metric: Evo2 perplexity (ppl_median) + ORF-valid rate at every alpha

output_case_spotcheck.note: At alpha=1 ORFs valid & fluent; at alpha=16 valid fluent low-helix DNA (not a fluency/validity collapse) -- metric tracks text.

steering_coefficient_sweep.details: 7-point sweep incl. alpha=0 spanning 32x; alpha is a reproducible raw multiplier on a fixed vector from unit SAE decoder directions x median-positive activations; target %-helix + independent perplexity & ORF-validity logged at every point; positive plateau {0.5,1,2} with collapse at alpha>=4; locked alpha=1 interior to plateau and met held-out criteria (n=2205, p<0.05); norm-matched random-direction and random-feature controls (n=300) beaten by the learned direction; no asymmetric sign requirement.
